syllabus_metadata.title: Biology Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education

competences.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the concepts, principles and processes of Biology
competences.specific_competence: 1.1 Describe the physiological, anatomical and ecological processes of living organisms

learning_activities.activity: (a) Describe nutrition in human and ruminants (nutrients, digestive system and processes)
teaching_learning_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on the concept of nutrition in human and ruminants
Jigsaw: Guide students to explore nutrients, nutritional deficiency and disorders through jigsaw
ICT-Based learning: Guide student to explain the digestive system, digestion processes in human and ruminants through simulation
Group discussion: Guide students in manageable groups to discuss diseases and disorders of human digestive system
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Nutrition in human and ruminants is described clearly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Variety of food substances, charts/pictures displaying variety of food nutrients, models/charts of human and ruminant digestive system, dissected mammal specimen displaying digestive system, charts/photographs showing common disorders and diseases of human digestive system

learning_activities.activity: (b) Describe the mechanism of transportation of materials in flowering plants (vascular system, absorption and movement of water and mineral salts and transpiration)
teaching_learning_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on the concept of transportation of materials in flowering plants
Group discussion: Guide students in manageable groups to discuss vascular system
ICT based learning: Guide students to explain absorption and movement of water and mineral salts in plants and transpiration process through simulation
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Mechanism of transportation of materials in flowering plants is described clearly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Charts/model/photographs showing transportation of materials in plants, relevant equipment and apparati, stain, potted plants, germinated seeds, and transportation of materials in plants online resources

learning_activities.activity: (c) Describe the mechanism of transportation of materials in the human body (the mammalian heart, blood vessels, blood, blood circulation)
teaching_learning_methods: Question and answers: Guide students to explain factors affecting rate of transpiration through questions and answers
Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on the concept of transportation of materials in human body
Field trip: Guide students to visit nearby health facility to learn about blood cells, blood groups, blood pressure and blood transfusion
ICT-Based learning: Guide students to explain the structure of the heart and blood circulation in human through simulation
Group discussion: Guide students in manageable groups to discuss the importance of blood circulation, diseases and disorders of the human circulatory system
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The mechanism of transportation of materials in the human body are described clearly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Mammalian heart models/charts/photographs, blood circulatory system online resources, dissected mammal displaying the heart and major blood vessels and charts showing diseases and disorders of human circulatory system

learning_activities.activity: (d) Describe the mechanisms of gaseous exchange and respiration in mammals (gaseous exchange in mammals, aerobic and anaerobic respiration)
teaching_learning_methods: Brainstorm: Guide students to brainstorm the concept of gaseous exchange and respiration in mammals
ICT-based learning: Guide students to explain the mechanism of gaseous exchange and respiration in mammals through simulation/animation/video
Group discussion: Guide students in manageable groups to discuss on factors affecting the rate of gaseous exchange and respiration in mammals
Guest speaker: Invite guest speaker to share with students on various infections and diseases of respiratory system
Exploration: Guide students to explore how aerobic and anaerobic respiration are applied in their real life
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The mechanisms of gaseous exchange and respiration in mammals are described clearly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Models/photographs/charts showing structure of the lungs and alveolus in human, online resources on gaseous exchange and respiration in mammals

learning_activities.activity: (e) Describe the mechanism of gaseous exchange in plants (parts of plants responsible for gaseous exchange and the process)
teaching_learning_methods: Questions and answers: Guide students to explain the concept of gaseous exchange in plants through question and answers
ICT based learning: Guide students to explain the mechanism of gaseous exchange in plants through simulation/animation/video
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The mechanism of gaseous exchange in plants is described clearly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Plant leaves, photographs showing the structure of stomata, potted plants, charts/pictures of gaseous exchange in plants, and gaseous exchange in plants online resources

competences.specific_competence: 2.1 Demonstrate mastery of basic skills for conducting biological investigations

learning_activities.activity: (a) Investigate food nutrients in various food samples
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Guide students in manageable groups to explore the scientific procedures required to conduct food test
Laboratory practical: Guide students to investigate food nutrients in various food samples
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Food nutrients in various food samples are investigated correctly using the scientific procedures
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Relevant reagents and chemicals, various food samples, apparati and source of heat

learning_activities.activity: (b) Investigate processes of transportation of materials in flowering plants
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Guide students in manageable groups to discuss procedures/steps for investigating processes of transportation of materials in flowering plants
Experimentation: Guide students to investigate processes of transportation of materials in flowering plants
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Processes of transportation of materials in flowering plants are investigated correctly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Diagram/video showing transverse section of living plant tissues, mounted slides of plant tissues, relevant reagents and chemicals, source of heat, plants with variegated leaves, distilled water, ringed plant, charts/video showing transportation of materials in plants, and online resources on transportation of materials in plants

learning_activities.activity: (c) Carry out experiments to determine the pulse rate in human
teaching_learning_methods: Experimentation: Guide students to carry out experiment to determine pulse rate among themselves
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Experiments to determine the pulse rate in human are carried out correctly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Blood pressure machine, smartphone app, digital fitness trackers and exercise machine

learning_activities.activity: (d) Investigate aerobic and anaerobic respiration in living organisms
teaching_learning_methods: Experimentation: Guide students to investigate aerobic and anaerobic respiration in living organisms through experiment
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Aerobic and anaerobic respiration in living organisms are investigated correctly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Charts/diagrams on aerobic and anaerobic respiration of living organisms

competences.specific_competence: 2.2 Prepare and present results of biological investigations

learning_activities.activity: (a) Prepare and present a report of a biological investigation on (food nutrients in various food samples, transportation of materials in flowering plants, pulse rate in human, aerobic and anaerobic respiration)
teaching_learning_methods: Project: Guide students to prepare biological investigation report using scientific steps/procedures
Presentation: Guide students to present a biological investigation report
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: A biological investigation report is prepared and presented correctly using scientific procedures
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Steps/procedures for biological investigations online resources
